localBiteReport: Redfish and speckled trout are the top inshore targets on Choctawhatchee Bay right now, with water temperature at 67°F. Reds have been active around bait schools, shorelines, and where baitfish are funneling into creeks and rivers — finding concentrations of bait has been the key to locating feeding fish. Speckled trout are becoming an increasingly reliable target as cooler temperatures settle in; look for them around deeper bayou holes, creek mouths, and transitions between shallow flats and deeper water, with northeast winds and tides playing a bigger role in bite timing. November is also a transitional month for flounder, as mature fish begin staging near the passes and moving offshore to spawn — inshore flounder opportunity is winding down but still worth targeting near East Pass and the Mid-Bay Bridge early in the week. The most recent reports with specific Choctawhatchee Bay inshore content are approximately one week old.
